  • Method Details

    • update

      void update(double overallPercent, double stagePercent, double operationPercent, String stageName, String operationName)
      Callback invoked (by native code) for progress updates.
      Parameters:
      overallPercent - an overall completion percentage (≥0, ≤100)
      stagePercent - a completion percentage for the current stage (≥0, ≤100)
      operationPercent - a completion percentage for the current operation (≥0, ≤100)
      stageName - the name of the current stage
      operationName - the name of the current operation
